unix.permissions: Mode 0000 file and traversable directory. Execute as an unprivileged account without a file-access override.

windows.permissions: Deny the scanner principal read-data access to the unreadable fixture. The principal must lack effective backup privilege and retain directory traversal.

empty-map.reason: The selected readable mapping contains no amber field.

missing-path.reason: The readable document contains no matching YAMLPath.

malformed.reason: An unclosed YAML sequence prevents collection of an authoritative comparison.

unreadable.reason: The bytes are valid, but the scanner lacks permission to acquire them.

expectation_boundary: A complete readable observation cannot match absent data. Exceptional outcomes follow the actual collection flag under the pinned OVAL result contract. Native collector status mapping requires independent qualification.
